run_pose_error_evaluation: run the eval_calc_errors script to calculate VSD pose errors for 6D object pose estimates on a BOP dataset
run_mssd_error_calculation: run the eval_calc_errors script with --error_type mssd to compute MSSD errors for symmetric objects
run_add_error_calculation: run the eval_calc_errors script with --error_type add to compute ADD errors for asymmetric objects
run_detection_mode_evaluation: run the eval_calc_errors script with --eval_mode detection to evaluate 6D object detection results
run_parallel_error_calculation: run the eval_calc_errors script with --num_workers 8 to calculate pose errors using 8 parallel workers
